blocks.text: A visual chart should have a useful name and a text explanation. A nearby table can provide exact values to readers who cannot use the picture.
Use a browser project with D3 7 installed. These module examples append an SVG to the page. Run one example at a time with a bundler; the plain playground does not include D3.

items: `aria-labelledby` points to the ids of elements that supply an accessible name. Keep those ids unique and present.
`aria-label` supplies a name to assistive technology. It should explain the same purpose as the visible control or graphic.

blocks.text: The SVG has an accessible title and description as well as visible summary text.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Do not claim a title alone explains a complex chart. Include the important trends and exact data in usable text.
